method: Soak the chickpeas overnight. Drain and rinse well.
Pressure cook the chickpeas with the halved potato, bay leaf, cooking soda, salt and enough water to cover, for 4-5 whistles on high, then simmer 5 minutes. Let the pressure release naturally.
Blend the potato, 1 tbsp of the chickpeas, the curd and a splash of water to a smooth purée.
Heat the mustard oil until smoking. Add the onion, ginger and chopped green chillies and cook until golden.
Add the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and chana masala. Mix well.
Pour in the curd mix and cook, stirring, until the oil separates from the gravy.
Add the remaining chickpeas and their cooking liquid. Season with salt and sugar and simmer a few minutes until thick and mushy.
For the tadka, crackle the slit chillies and ginger in hot ghee with the kasuri methi and hing, and pour over. Garnish with coriander and serve.
